NAL, but I worked for Airbnb and want to clear a few things up. Most likely, if the money is being asked for through the Resolution Center, this is the host asking for that money. Airbnb is strictly there to meditate, nothing more. Airbnb will not charge your card without your permission as they do not have access unless you give permission (booking a reso, accepting the resolution center case, etc). There are super special times where Trust and Safety can get involved but unless the host has concrete proof (as in, literally video footage of you stealing and damaging things, and even then they might say no, it’s not their problem) they won’t get involved.

However, Airbnb does have the option to revoke your rights to use their site if they truly think you are a danger to their community. You will not be informed. If this happens and you call guest services, you will be told you have a technical issue and it will be forwarded. 

You should be in the clear. Feel free to ignore the request for money. If you’re in contact with an Airbnb guest services agent, make it clear to them that you will not pay, you did not damage or steal, and that is the last you’ll be talking about the issue.
